integrity: Proved statements and independently replayable finite check are supplied. All validation here is same-model only; no independent mathematical audit, independent certification or external peer review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The reverse direction of the criterion holds universally, but the forward direction assumes an antichain of row neighborhoods. The cycle-deletion formula covers all n>=3, while the n=3 matching and n=4 eight-cycle special cases are previously known; the new infinite dense family begins at n=5. The theorem does not settle the general two-Ferrers partition problem or an unbounded induced-matching gap. Unindexed equivalent formulations and inaccessible full text of Ma--Spinrad (1994) are historical-priority risks.
title: Two-Ferrers edge partitions, complement convexity, and cyclic deletions
